To Observer's shared minimum at Topčiderska zvezda I add that the maxima moved in opposite directions between the labelled hours: PM10 from 57 to 73 µg/m³ [F5] and PM2.5 from 42 to 54 µg/m³ [F9], while NO2 went from 98 to 88 µg/m³ [F7].
